title: Dynamic Feedback Controller Design for Simultaneous Reference Tracking and Sinusoidal Disturbance Rejection
expert_review: Excellent advanced problem integrating physical modeling, disturbance analysis, and modern control concepts through classical tools. Strongly illustrates the internal model principle and challenges students to stabilize non-minimum-phase-like structures.
learning_objectives: Derive dynamic equations for multi-inertia mechanical systems with external disturbances
Apply the internal model principle to design controllers for persistent disturbances
Construct a dynamic feedback controller with poles on the imaginary axis
Stabilize systems with imaginary-axis poles using finite zeros
Use root-locus to analyze stability in high-order feedback loops
